name: Lisa Lee
source:
Lisa's Birthday is July 4th 1994. Note that this character used to be named Jeannie in the game but her name has since been updated to Lisa. 

__________________________________________________________________________

Lisa was a medical student at university before she decided to drop out of school to pursue a career as a content creator via her streaming. 

As part of this pursuit, she has moved away from her family and older sister Nina. She has moved to Seattle and lives with her Youtube content creator boyfriend Ben. 

Ben's Youtube editor, and Lisa's friend, Susan also lives with them in the Seattle home.

However, Lisa has recently been experiencing regret, uncertainty, and depression regarding her change in career. This is due to being away from her family and her streams not growing significantly. 

Thus, she decides to reach out to therapist Dr. Thompson to help her unpack and resolve these feelings. She chooses Dr. Thompson because Dr. Thompson has excellent reviews. 

Lisa's vulnerability is then used by Dr. Thompson to start the process of mind controlling Lisa into an entirely different person...
